content.short: ChainPro is a zero-fee, non-custodial trading terminal aimed at professional traders.
content.description: ChainPro provides a non-custodial terminal for active traders with no platform fee, keeping assets in the user's own wallet rather than an exchange account. Non-custodial terminals trade the convenience of a hosted account for the removal of counterparty risk, which is a trade more traders have been willing to make since 2022.
content.meta: A non-custodial terminal for active traders that charges no platform fee.
